we have developed a simple and efficient method to isolate multipotent precursors, based on the increase in EGFG receptor levels in late development.

we have identified a novel population of multipotent precusors that express high levels of EGFP, that we have demonstrated that EGFP expression correlates with the ability of precusors to migrate and that EGFR levels may be used as a simple and efficient marker to isolate multipotent precursors.
we have identified a simple procedure to isolate telencephalon stem cells from embryonic and adults brain.

the development of a novel method for the isolation of multipotent precurosors that can be used to study the biology of these cells and to generate transplantable cell lines.
the development of a new method to isolate neural precursors that may be used in the clinic.
the development of a new method to isolate neural stem and precursor cells.

the increase in EGRF levels, that occurs during the development, is used by the brain to regulate the migratory properties of the stem cells.

EGFR is a good marker to identify multipotent precursors in the developing brain.

EGFR(high) multipotent precursors are enriched in late developing brain and that their migration is promoted by EGF/EGFR signaling.
